tldr: First run since 2026-06-05 (routine was paused ~9 weeks). No backlog items closed in this window, but five materially relevant PRs shipped: (a) Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure went live (PR #108, 2026-07-11) — homepage spotlight section + team-card ribbon + profile hero badge, all editable in the CMS under Homepage → Practitioner Spotlight — first cadenced fresh-content surface the site has ever had (partial address for #14). (b) ACC copy site-wide was rewritten from 'we lodge claims for you' to 'ACC-registered provider' framing (PR #113, 2026-07-29) after Google Ads disapproved the clinic under the 'Government documents and official services' policy — factual and correct, but changes the angle item #25 (/acc/ landing page) needs to take. (c) Jonathan Grice promoted to Senior Osteopath & Low Level Laser Therapist site-wide (PR #103, 2026-06-23) — Physician JSON-LD updated to match. (e) Cliniko booking funnel now tracked as GA4 conversions with real booking_completed events, not click proxies (PR #116, 2026-07-29) — pairs with #35 for end-to-end attribution once the GSC Gen AI report has data. Backlog after this run: 8 items pending (#12, #13, #14, #15, #16, #25, #32, #35).

Search visibility: 30 queries re-checked against live SERPs on 2026-08-07. **MAJOR WIN — FIRST-EVER appearance of meridianosteopathy.co.nz in the tracked pool: rank #9 for 'tennis elbow osteopath christchurch', ranked via /conditions/sports-injury-recovery/.** The UK-side domains crowding the top of the SERP (balancedmotionclinic.co.uk, theosteopaths.org.uk, therichardscentre.co.uk) suggest a slightly hollow local SERP that let our sports-injury page break through on partial-topic relevance — the win is real, but conditional. Priority held at 15 per the rank 4–10 rule (which keeps priority unchanged). Elsewhere the picture is unchanged: rank 0 across the other 29 queries checked, so the standard -10 decay applied everywhere else. **NOTABLE REGRESSION**: 'osteopath vs physiotherapist christchurch' — the ≥5-spot drop flagged last run has NOT recovered; Better Health now holds top 3 slots with three comparison-URL variants (SERP consolidating around one competitor, not volatility as previously hedged). **NOTABLE NEW COMPETITORS this run**: Frame Osteo jumped to #1 for 'osteopath christchurch' (was outside top 5); Triskelion Concussion Care expanded beyond concussion into 'neck pain osteopath christchurch' at #2; Performance Plus Physio (performanceplusphysiochch.co.nz) is a new physio contender for sports-injury + Addington; acupuncturepainrelief.co.nz took #1 for 'medical acupuncture christchurch'; headachetendon.nz (a chiropractor with a content-heavy strategy) surged to #1 for 'lower back pain christchurch'. Four queries pruned this run: 'osteopath wigram' + 'osteopath addington' (2+ months post item #29 suburb inclusion with hollow SERPs unchanged), 'osteopath near me halswell' (US-directory hollow SERP), 'headaches migraines osteopath christchurch' (superseded by cleaner 'headaches osteopath christchurch' variant). Five derived queries added: 'acupuncture for menstrual pain christchurch' (tests Min Jin's dysmenorrhoea specialty), 'hip pain osteopath christchurch' + 'knee pain osteopath christchurch' (natural condition-page gaps), 'sports injury recovery christchurch' (tests whether the tennis-elbow #9 rank generalises to the exact URL slug), 'postpartum osteopath christchurch' (US-variant of postnatal). Pool size 46/50.

Industry signals (week of 2026-07-31 → 2026-08-07): (1) **GSC Generative AI report added CTR + regional rollout** — Google extended the Search Console AI performance report beyond impressions to include CTR (clicks ÷ impressions) in July, and rolled it to more regions. Query-level data still absent. Reinforces #35 (now a Tier-1 no-brainer). (2) **AI Mode is default + queries doubling** — Gemini 3.5 Flash now powers every Google query globally; AI Mode passed 1B MAU; queries are 3× longer than classic search; only 17–54% of AI Overview citations come from top-10 organic (down from 76% mid-2025). Raw rank is decoupling from citation. Reinforces the passage-extractability strategy already baked into #31. (3) **Reddit = 46.7% of Perplexity top-10 citation share** — Tinuiti Q1 2026 held; SaaSIntelligence follow-up shows Reddit share grew 73% across verticals. Only ~11% ChatGPT/Perplexity domain overlap. Reinforces #15 hard — single highest-leverage AEO lever for Perplexity visibility. (4) **Review recency = #1 individual local ranking factor** — Whitespark 2026 report + Epicware July analysis: reviews <30 days carry full weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; Gemini/AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which businesses to recommend. Reinforces #16 and #13 hard. (5) **Ahrefs schema study holds up + FAQ rich results deprecated** — +2.4% AI Mode / +2.2% ChatGPT / –4.6% AI Overviews across 1,885 pages adding schema; consensus in late July: schema is a context signal, not a lever. Downweights #12. (6) **ClaudeBot overtook GPTBot in crawler share** — ClaudeBot 16.28% / GPTBot 9.74% (Cloudflare July 2026); Google confirmed llms.txt has zero ranking effect (2026-06-15). Our existing Claude-SearchBot allow line (item #33) is validated; don't extend llms.txt investment. (7) **88% of health queries trigger AI Overviews; 83% zero-click** — passage-level clarity on condition pages is the extraction unit. Reinforces #32 (concussion page) and #25 (ACC page). Tier 1 → #35. Tier 2 → #13, #16, #25, #32 (all with elevated urgency). Tier 3 → #14, #15.

gaps.title: No blog / editorial content
gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. Confirmed again 2026-08-07: 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within 30 days; 70% of AI Overview cited pages churn within 2–3 months (Search Engine Journal July 2026 study on AI Mode after one year); content updated within the past two months earns 28% more AI citations than older material. osteopath-christchurch.com still winning headache/migraine/cranial/baby-osteo/arthritis queries on blog-post velocity; MK Osteopathy does the same for TMJ; headachetendon.nz (a chiropractor with a content-heavy strategy) surged to #1 for 'lower back pain christchurch' this run — new evidence of the same pattern. The May 2026 Ahrefs schema study (+2.4% AI Mode / +2.2% ChatGPT / –4.6% AIO across 1,885 pages) removes schema as a competing investment lever; content depth + freshness are what remain. Meridian's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure (PR #108) is the closest thing we have to blog cadence — one entry per month, homepage-surface only, not a separate URL. Item #14 covers the full blog build; #14's file-list note now says the Spotlight infrastructure is a starting point the blog collection can graft onto rather than a from-scratch build.

gaps.title: No off-site citation strategy
gaps.why: Reddit is 46.7% of Perplexity top-10 citation share (Tinuiti Q1 2026 held; SaaSIntelligence follow-up shows Reddit share grew 73% across verticals in the tracked window). ChatGPT ~5%, Gemini 0.1%. Only ~11% domain overlap between ChatGPT and Perplexity citations, so Perplexity visibility is decided by Reddit presence in a way ChatGPT's isn't. ClaudeBot overtook GPTBot at 16.28% vs 9.74% of AI-bot crawler traffic in July 2026 (Cloudflare) — Reddit is increasingly the path into Claude's answers too. Item #15 still the highest-leverage AEO lever we have and still un-attempted; 90/10 non-promotional-first rule applies.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. DOWNWEIGHTED 2026-08-07: the Ahrefs schema-impact study (+2.4% AI Mode / +2.2% ChatGPT / –4.6% AIO across 1,885 pages) held up in late-July commentary; consensus is schema is a context signal, not a lever. Speakable specifically has been in beta 7 years without leaving beta. Keep on the list because it's still cheap, but do NOT invest engineering time in more schema types over body-copy work.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report now names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor (reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month per Epicware July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend, so review freshness feeds both the Local Pack AND the AI-citation layer. Combined with #16, this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end — bump up in effective priority even though tier stays 2.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
files: PR #108 Practitioner Spotlight infra can be extended rather than a from-scratch build
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. Confirmed 2026-08-07: 70% of AI Overview cited pages churn within 2–3 months (Search Engine Journal July 2026 AI-Mode-after-one-year study); pages updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns TMJ the same way; headachetendon.nz (a chiropractor) surged to #1 for 'lower back pain christchurch' this run — fresh evidence that content-heavy strategies from adjacent modalities are colonising slots we could otherwise take. STARTING POINT SHORTER THAN IT WAS: PR #108 shipped a Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure with CMS wiring — the Decap collection config, JSON-LD, homepage surface and image handling can be adapted rather than built from scratch. Consensus in late-July commentary: depth > velocity — 2 posts/month is fine if each is genuinely useful, not a content-marketing treadmill.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Reddit is 46.7% of Perplexity top-10 citation share (SaaSIntelligence follow-up on Tinuiti Q1 2026 data shows Reddit share grew 73% across nine tracked verticals). ChatGPT ~5%, Gemini 0.1%. Only ~11% domain overlap between ChatGPT and Perplexity citations — Perplexity visibility is decided by Reddit presence in a way ChatGPT's isn't. ClaudeBot overtook GPTBot in crawler share at 16.28% vs 9.74% for all of July 2026 (Cloudflare) — Reddit is increasingly the path into Claude's answers too. This is now the single highest-leverage AEO lever we have and still un-attempted. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor. Reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month (Epicware / DigitalApplied July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend — freshness now compounds across Local Pack AND AI citation. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report + capture baseline
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. UPDATED 2026-08-07: the opt-out toggle went live 2026-06-17 (51+ days ago); since properties are opt-in by default, the report should still be capturing unless someone explicitly disabled it. In mid-July Google extended the report to include CTR (clicks ÷ impressions, not just impressions) and rolled it to additional regions — first proper delta between AI-surface impressions and site visits. This is the only first-party way to measure AI-search visibility for meridianosteopathy.co.nz (citation overlap with the organic top-10 collapsed to 17–54% post-Gemini-3.5, so traditional rank tracking now misses the majority of the AI-surface story). Action items: (1) verify meridianosteopathy.co.nz is a verified property in the clinic's GSC account, (2) confirm the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is still ON, (3) screenshot the report's default 3-month window as a 'pre-blog' baseline (~2 months of data now available) before item #14 ships, (4) note the new CTR column pairs directly with the GA4 booking_completed conversion event added in PR #116 — full AI-surface → click → booking attribution becomes possible once GSC data has settled. No code changes needed.
